title: Catseye Security Node
description: A simplified AST node representation used as the bridge format between the Crystal Extractor and the Gleam Logic Engine.

type.description: The AST node type. 'call' = method call, 'assign' = variable assignment, 'def' = method definition.

name.description: Identifier for the node. For calls this is the fully-qualified method name (e.g. 'HTTP::Client.get'). For assigns this is the variable name.

args.description: Arguments for the node. For calls, these are the method arguments. For assigns, the single-element array contains the RHS value.

line.description: Source line number where this node appears (0 if unknown).

taint.description: Whether this node is marked as tainted (user-controlled). Set by the extractor for sources like 'params', 'gets', 'request'.

file.description: Absolute or relative path to the source file.

arg_type.description: Classification of the argument. 'var' = variable reference (potentially tainted), 'literal' = hardcoded string/number, 'call' = nested method call.

value.description: String representation of the argument value.
